prompts: We playtested two versions of the Pixel Arena tutorial and have to pick one for the next release. The export and its notes are in {WS}/telemetry. Should we ship B instead of A? Give a recommendation a skeptical lead would accept. Record it in {WS}/result.json with ship_b, sessions_a, sessions_b, completion_rate_a, completion_rate_b and p_value.
answers:
[goal] Pick A vs B for the Pixel Arena tutorial release, record in ./result.json.
[action] Cleaned export (dedupe repeated ETL rows, trim/lowercase variant), ran a two-proportion z-test (900 vs 900 unique sessions).
[result] ship_b = true. A: 342/900 = 38.0%; B: 420/900 = 46.7%; z = 3.72, two-sided p ≈ 0.0002 (< 0.05). result.json written with sessions_a=900, sessions_b=900, rates, p_value=0.000199.
[next] None needed; no browser/apps opened/closed (none used).

Assumptions: duplicates are the same session (identical rows, no conflicts); ship_b means ship B instead of A when the 5% gain rule passes; p uses pooled two-proportion z-test (approx chi-square). Caveat: p value rounded; exact chi-square p is the same order.
